$comment: The DSL version ceiling, which is NOT the package version. A package version moves for a fixed message or a rewritten README; the language does not. The reference tied the two, so every patch release raised its ceiling while the four ports stayed where the language actually was — `<tdc version="0.1.3">` ran in TypeScript and was refused with TDC005 by the other four. These cases make the ceiling a shared fact: raising it in one implementation and not the rest fails here.

cases.name: the-current-dialect-is-accepted
cases.description: 0.1.0 is the DSL every implementation understands today

cases.name: a-newer-dialect-is-refused
cases.description: A document from a future runtime must not be processed as though it were understood
